_provenance.source: https://balbriggan.ie/ — theme style.css, quaystreet.css, learning-style.css, Bootstrap 4 theme.min.css, slick-theme.css, Gravity Forms legacy CSS; measure.mjs at 1440/360 (stardust/replica/lift/measure-live*.txt)

medium.use: nav top menu, buttons, card titles, grid labels

heroHeading.note: the source names a family that does not exist; it renders Arial/Helvetica bold

type.h2: 32px/38.4px GothamBold weight 500 uppercase #3c3c3c, margin 0 0 8px; section variant adds a 5px yellow rule 10% wide, margin .5em auto 1.5em

buttons.pill: bg #f5ee2f, color #2494d2, border 2px #f5ee2f, radius 2rem, padding .15rem 2rem, GothamMedium 16px 700 uppercase
buttons.submit: bg #f5ee2f, color #2494d2, border 2px, radius .25rem, padding .5rem 1.5rem, 16px 700 uppercase

layout.header: sticky, 98px at 1440 (padding 8px 16px), 90px at 360; logo 11rem×4.5rem (3rem tall <576); .scrolled after 100px: logo 9rem×3.5rem, padding .1rem
layout.hero: 70vh, min 15rem; centred white card max 37rem, padding 3rem (3rem 2rem + margin 2rem <992)
layout.newsCards: 3 per view; card radius 1.5rem, image 9rem, title min-height 9rem; gutter 30px
layout.exploreGrid: 4 columns, gap 20px, rows 15vw, first tile 2×2, overlay rgba(60,60,60,.7)
layout.documents: auto-width columns centred, 212px covers; even columns title below
